verdict.rationale: MX documents developer API keys and key rotation through the Client Dashboard, but nothing shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent for least-privilege access. Plain API keys are an adjacent control, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: log in to Client Dashboard and select **API keys** to access your developer API keys.
Once a rotation is initiated, your previous API key will expire in 30 days.
